summary: Destroys a linked list rooted at this[0]. Walks nodes via the next-link pointer (node+4). For each node whose flag byte at +8 is non-zero and whose data pointer at +0 is non-null, dereferences the data block's first DWORD as the block base and calls NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH(block, 4156, count-at-(block-4), EmptyStub_aa60) before freeing the block base and the data wrapper. Every node wrapper is freed with FreeWrapper_7bcf. Finally zeroes all four list-structure DWORDs and returns 0.

operations.description: Require the head pointer stored at this[0] to be non-null before entering the destruction walk.
do-while walk over nodes, advancing via the next-link DWORD at node+4 until it is null.
Per node, require the flag byte at node+8 to be non-zero before processing the node's data.
Per node, require the data pointer at node+0 to be non-null.
Require the first DWORD of the data block (dereferenced data pointer) to be non-null before the callback loop.
Call NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH with the data block base, entry size 4156, a count read from the 4 bytes preceding the block base, and the EmptyStub_aa60 callback.
Free the block base (data first-DWORD minus 4) with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the node's data wrapper pointer (node+0) with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free each node wrapper with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Zero the four list-structure DWORDs this[0] (head), this[4] (tail), this[8] (cursor), this[0xC] (count) and set result to 0.
